formulas.ascii: Samples sit at cell centres; a corner is high when value >= level. On each cell edge whose ends differ, with a and b the canonical start and end samples (+x or +y), the vertex is p_a + t (p_b - p_a), t = (level - v_a) / (v_b - v_a). A segment joins each high-to-low exit edge to its paired entry edge (on a saddle cell the high corners are joined when the bilinear saddle value (v0 v2 - v1 v3) / (v0 + v2 - v1 - v3) >= level, decided by the sign of (v0 - L)(v2 - L) - (v1 - L)(v3 - L)); a cell with a nodata corner emits nothing; vertices are relative to localOrigin; segments sharing an edge are stitched into polylines.
